# Classy Fonts

> Free to use and free to redistribute are different rights, so this cabinet keeps them in separate tabs.

Canonical page: https://anishfyi.com/classy-fonts/
Source: https://github.com/anishfyi/classy-fonts
Author: Anish Kr Singh (anishfyi), https://anishfyi.com/

## What it is

A specimen cabinet of 324 free typefaces separated by what the licence actually permits: 192 faces safe for commercial use, 132 for personal use only, each shown as a live specimen.

## Facts

- Catalogues 324 free typefaces as live specimens, with the interface set in the fonts it catalogues.
- 192 faces are safe for commercial use. Of those, 110 OFL and Apache faces are vendored in the repository as real .woff2 and .ttf files with their own OFL.txt and designer credit, and 82 Fontshare faces are served live from the foundry's own CDN as their licence permits.
- 132 faces are free for personal use only and are shown as specimens linking to the designer's page, because their licences do not grant redistribution.
- The split exists because a font being free to use does not make it free to re-host. The Fontshare EULA, for instance, permits unlimited personal and commercial use but forbids uploading the files to a public server.
- The font catalogue was gathered with curl_reap.

## Questions and answers

### What is Classy Fonts?

Classy Fonts is a curated cabinet of 324 free typefaces, browsable as a live type-specimen gallery and split by what each licence actually permits.

### Which of these fonts can I use commercially?

192 of the 324 faces are safe for commercial work and all are free. The other 132 are free for personal projects only and need a licence from the author for commercial use.

### Why are some fonts downloadable and others only linked?

Free to use and free to redistribute are different rights. The 110 OFL and Apache faces are vendored in the repository because their licences allow re-hosting. Fontshare faces are served from the foundry's own CDN because their EULA permits unlimited use but forbids uploading the files to a public server.

### Are the font files hosted here?

110 OFL and Apache faces are, as real .woff2 and .ttf files with their OFL.txt and designer credit. The 82 Fontshare faces are served live from the foundry CDN, and the 132 personal-use faces are specimens that link to the designer.

### How was the catalogue built?

The fonts were gathered with curl_reap and the site is generated from a JSON data file.
